name: JSP Corp
summary: JSP Corporation is a global manufacturer and distributor of expanded polymer products. The company's diverse offerings include specialized material solutions such as ARPRO, an advanced impact energy management material frequently employed in automotive applications, reusable transport containers, and HVAC system housings. Another key product, STYRODIA, serves various purposes including packaging for consumer electronics, thermal insulation for food and beverages, construction insulation, and civil engineering components. FOAMCORE, a third material, is designed for use in prefabricated bathroom modules and automobile parts. Furthermore, JSP provides a variety of sheet and board products, marketed under names like MIRAMAT, CAPLON, P-BOARD, STYRENE PAPER, MIRABOARD, and MIRAFOAM. These products are crucial for industries ranging from advertising signage and construction to food and industrial packaging. Founded in 1962, JSP Corporation is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan, and functions as a subsidiary of Mitsubishi Gas Chemical Company, Inc.
